children: Citi Research analysts Michael Ward and Vikram Bagri initiated coverage of Rivian
with a Neutral rating, reflecting risks with the R2 launch and the challenges Rivian
The R1S, R1T, EDV, and R2 are currently in production at Rivian’s

Normal, Illinois facility. By Citi’s estimate, this plant has an annual production capacity of 120K but has been underutilized, with 2025 output at just 42,417 units, or about 35% of the facility’s production capacity.

This leads Ward and Bagri to question market estimates over Rivian’s production and sales targets. The current FactSet consensus estimate has the company delivering 82K R2s in 2027, suggesting production of over 1,500 units a week, while the consensus R2 sales estimate for 2028 is 183K, both of which Ward and Bagri believe “are not attainable.”

“Production is expected to accelerate in 2029, but in order to meet the 300,000-capacity target, distribution locations will need to more than double from current levels, and the market would need to expand significantly. In our view, the consensus R2 sales estimate for 2028 is assuming a faster ramp at the Georgia plant,” expected to start production in late 2028.
Accordingly, the analysts believe monthly sales and production data over the next 6-9 months will likely be the most important metrics to monitor.
